skills.name: Wind Scar (風の傷)
skills.description:
Inuyasha wields his Tessaiga to launch a heavy strike at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK with a 10% chance of gaining 1 layer of Force of Wind after the attack.
Gains 1 layer of Force of Wind at the of his turn. ;Force of Wind (風の纏) : : '''Buff, Mark''': Max 5 layers. Increases SPD by 10 and damage dealt by 5% per layer.

skills.name: Backlash Wave (爆流破)
skills.description:
Whenever an enemy consumes onibi, and Inuyasha is not Immobile, he has 10% chance (increases by 16% for each Force of Wind layer) of launching a counter-attack on that enemy, dealing damage equal to 176% of his ATK before consuming all Force of Wind layers. Each layer consumed increases the damage by 10%.

skills.name: Diamond Tessaiga (金剛鉄砕牙)
skills.description:
Inherits the effects of Red Tessaiga.
When dealing damage, ignores 40% of DEF.

skills.name: Dragon-scaled Tessaiga (竜鱗の鉄砕牙)
skills.description:
Inherits the all of the effects of Diamond Tessaiga.
Before Inuyasha attacks, dispels 1 buff from the target. If a buff is dispelled, increases his Crit DMG by 10% up to a max of 70%, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Black Tessaiga (漆黒鉄砕牙)
skills.description:
Inherits the all of the effects of Dragon-scaled Tessaiga.
When dealing damage, 50% of the damage reduces the target's max HP up to a max of 20%.
Launching counter-attacks no longer consumes Force of Wind layers (damage increase effect for each layer remains).

skills.name: Tessaiga (鉄砕牙)
skills.description: Inuyasha strikes random enemies 7 times, dealing damage equal to 40% of his ATK with each strike. Also has an 80% chance of attacking an additional random enemy. ;Force of Wind (風の纏) : : '''Buff, Mark''': Max 5 layers. Increases SPD by 10 and damage dealt by 5% per layer.
